findings: Goodell Creek's official RV and trailer maximum is 20 feet, not 38 feet.
Colonial Creek North closed to vehicle camping for the season on September 14, 2026.
Colonial Creek South closed to vehicles September 14; only ten walk-in tent-only sites remain.
Newhalem Loop C closed September 14 while Loops A and B remain first-come through September 27.
The 107-site Newhalem figure is total campground inventory, not 107 confirmed RV sites.
Cougar Rock's 2026 dump and fill station closure and current campfire ban were missing from the public summary.
result: All five critical trust fields are now supported for the seven reviewed national-park records.
